en.title: Disappearing "vertical writing" culture as smartphone and tablet use reduces opportunities - National survey on the Japanese language
en.summary: A government survey found that nearly 60% of Japanese people believe vertical writing traditions should be valued, yet daily usage opportunities are limited, with about half of people in their 20s reporting no vertical writing use. Smartphones and digital devices are expected to make horizontal writing the dominant format going forward.
